import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.ModulesPushforwardBaseChange
import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafH0BaseChange

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelEtaleSurjectiveH0BaseChange
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelEtaleSurjectiveSite

/-!
# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus

An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
test and ties every piece of data to the input class:

* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.

No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
  CartesianMonoidalCategory

open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]

/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.

The two equality fields prevent an unrelated cocycle datum or line bundle from serving as a
witness: `representative` presents the input plus class, `datum_class` presents that same
relative Picard class, and `module_iso` identifies the resulting cocycle sheaf with the
underlying base-ring sheaf of `module`. -/
structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
  representative : descentClasses C cover
  represents :
    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
  datum_class :
    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
  module : (relCurve C cover.Carrier).Modules
  module_iso :
    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
      (Over.mk (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier))) module ≅ datum.sheaf
  line_bundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle module
  native_pushforward_base_change :
    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app module)
  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
  h0_rank_one :
    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1

namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation

variable {pi} {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}

noncomputable local instance presentationModuleSections
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) (U : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens) :
    Module P.cover.Carrier Γ(P.module, U) :=
  Scheme.moduleKSections
    (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))) P.module U

/-- The canonical `H^0` base-change equivalence attached to a rank-one presentation.

This is derived from `P.h1_vanishing`; it is not an independently chosen witness. -/
noncomputable def h0BaseChange (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
    B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] (Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B]
      Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0 :=
  P.datum.datumH0BaseChange B
    ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing)

/-- The canonical evaluation map attached to a tied local rank-one presentation. -/
noncomputable def evaluation (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ⟶
      P.module :=
  (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module

/-! ## Native pushforward base change and evaluation coherence -/

/-- The canonical native pushforward base-change isomorphism supplied by the presentation.

The isomorphism is not chosen independently: its hom is definitionally
`(canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module`. -/
noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) := by
  exact @asIso _ _ _ _ ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module)
    (P.native_pushforward_base_change g f' g' sq)

/-- The native pushforward base-change isomorphism for an affine coefficient extension. -/
noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIsoAffine (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier B)))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) :=
  P.nativeBaseChangeIso
    (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))

/-- The source of evaluation identifies canonically with the source of evaluation after any
cartesian base change. -/
noncomputable def evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f').obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) :=
  ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).app

    45	/-- A witness at one prime is contained in a basic open on which the datum-pair H1
    46	fibre vanishes at every prime. -/
    47	theorem exists_basicOpen_h1_vanishing
    48	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    49	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom) (p : PrimeSpectrum B)
    50	    (hp : D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    51	    ∃ h : B, h ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B, h ∉ q.asIdeal →
    52	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] q.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
    53	  have hp' : Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
    54	    (D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton p.asIdeal.ResidueField).mp hp
    55	  obtain ⟨U, ⟨h, rfl⟩, hpU, hU⟩ :=
    56	    PrimeSpectrum.isTopologicalBasis_basic_opens.exists_subset_of_mem_open hp'
    57	      (datumRigidEngine_isOpen_vanishing D hpi)
    58	  refine ⟨h, (PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen h p).mp hpU, fun q hq => ?_⟩
    59	  exact hU ((PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen h q).mpr hq)

    61	/-- Fibrewise H1 vanishing on a basic open is the rigid-engine hypothesis for the
    62	datum pulled to its away localization. -/
    63	theorem hfib_baseChange_away
    64	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi) (h : B)
    65	    (hvan : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B, h ∉ q.asIdeal →
    66	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] q.asIdeal.ResidueField))
    67	    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away h)) :
    68	    Subsingleton ((datumPair (D.baseChange (Localization.Away h))).H1
    69	      ⊗[Localization.Away h] q.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
    70	  let p : PrimeSpectrum B :=
    71	    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B (Localization.Away h)) q
    72	  have hhp : h ∉ p.asIdeal := by
    73	    intro hh
    74	    refine q.isPrime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem q.asIdeal
    75	      (Ideal.mem_comap.mp hh) ?_)
    76	    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit h
    77	  have hp : Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
    78	    hvan p hhp
    79	  have hpw : D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    80	    (D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton p.asIdeal.ResidueField).mpr hp
    81	  have hunit : IsUnit (algebraMap B p.asIdeal.ResidueField h) :=
    82	    isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr fun h0 =>
    83	      hhp (Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_eq_zero.mp h0)
    84	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away h) p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    85	    (IsLocalization.Away.lift (S := Localization.Away h) h hunit).toAlgebra
    86	  haveI : IsScalarTower B (Localization.Away h) p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    87	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
    88	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.Away.lift_comp])
    89	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away h) p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    90	    isScalarTower_left_of_isScalarTower (R₀ := B)
    91	  have hcom : p.asIdeal = q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap B (Localization.Away h)) := rfl
    92	  let psi : p.asIdeal.ResidueField →+* q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    93	    Ideal.ResidueField.map p.asIdeal q.asIdeal
    94	      (algebraMap B (Localization.Away h)) hcom
    95	  letI : Algebra p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField := psi.toAlgebra
    96	  haveI : IsScalarTower B p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    97	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
    98	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
    99	      ext b
   100	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, Ideal.ResidueField.map_algebraMap,
   101	        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B (Localization.Away h)])
   102	  have hDq : D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   103	    (D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension
   104	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField).mp hpw
   105	  have hcl :
   106	      Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B q.asIdeal.ResidueField) D.cechPicClass =
   107	        Scheme.CechPic.map
   108	          (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away h) q.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   109	          (D.baseChange (Localization.Away h)).cechPicClass := by
   110	    rw [D.cechPicClass_baseChange (Localization.Away h),
   111	      ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
   112	      relCurveMap_comp]
   113	  have hDq' : (D.baseChange (Localization.Away h)).HasWitnessH1Vanishing
   114	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   115	    (D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_congr_of_cechPicClass_eq
   116	      (D.baseChange (Localization.Away h)) q.asIdeal.ResidueField hcl).mp hDq
   117	  exact ((D.baseChange (Localization.Away h)).hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton
   118	    q.asIdeal.ResidueField).mp hDq'

   121	neighbourhood of `p` is nontrivial. -/
   122	theorem nontrivial_away_tensor_of_nontrivial_fibre
   123	    {Q : Type u} [AddCommGroup Q] [Module B Q]
   124	    (p : PrimeSpectrum B) (h : B) (hh : h ∉ p.asIdeal)
   125	    (hp : Nontrivial (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[B] Q)) :
   126	    Nontrivial (Localization.Away h ⊗[B] Q) := by
   127	  have hunit : IsUnit (algebraMap B p.asIdeal.ResidueField h) :=
   128	    isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr fun h0 =>
   129	      hh (Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_eq_zero.mp h0)
   130	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away h) p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   131	    (IsLocalization.Away.lift (S := Localization.Away h) h hunit).toAlgebra
   132	  haveI : IsScalarTower B (Localization.Away h) p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   133	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
   134	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.Away.lift_comp])
   135	  by_contra hnt
   136	  rw [not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at hnt
   137	  have hleft : Subsingleton (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[Localization.Away h]
   138	      (Localization.Away h ⊗[B] Q)) := inferInstance
   139	  have hright : Subsingleton (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[B] Q) :=
   140	    (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange B (Localization.Away h)
   141	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField p.asIdeal.ResidueField Q).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mp hleft
   142	  exact (not_subsingleton (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[B] Q)) hright

   168	/-- A pulled datum class has unchanged degree at a prime lying over the base prime. -/
   169	theorem classDeg_map_residueField_of_comap
   170	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
   171	    {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] [Algebra B S]
   172	    [IsScalarTower k B S] (p : PrimeSpectrum B) (q : PrimeSpectrum S)
   173	    (hq : PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B S) q = p) (n : ℕ)
   174	    (hdegp : classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   175	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   176	        D.cechPicClass) = (n : ℤ)) :
   177	    classDeg q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   178	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B q.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   179	        D.cechPicClass) = (n : ℤ) := by
   180	  have hcom : p.asIdeal = q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap B S) := by
   181	    simpa using congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hq.symm
   182	  let rho : p.asIdeal.ResidueField →ₐ[k] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   183	    Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p.asIdeal q.asIdeal
   184	      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k B S) hcom
   185	  letI : Algebra p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   186	    rho.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   187	  haveI : IsScalarTower k p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   188	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (rho.commutes x).symm
   189	  haveI : IsScalarTower B p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   190	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
   191	      change algebraMap B q.asIdeal.ResidueField x =
   192	        rho (algebraMap B p.asIdeal.ResidueField x)
   193	      rw [Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ_apply, Ideal.ResidueField.map_algebraMap]
   194	      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B S q.asIdeal.ResidueField x
   195	  have hcurve : (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap rho).left =
   196	      relCurveMap C p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField := by
   197	    refine congrArg
   198	      (fun t : overSpec k q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⟶
   199	        overSpec k p.asIdeal.ResidueField => (C ◁ t).left) ?_
   200	    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
   201	  have hinv := classDeg_cechPicMap_baseFieldTransition C rho
   202	    (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   203	      D.cechPicClass)
   204	  rw [hcurve] at hinv
   205	  have hpic : Scheme.CechPic.map
   206	      (relCurveMap C p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   207	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   208	        D.cechPicClass) =
   209	      Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B q.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   210	        D.cechPicClass := by
   211	    rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, relCurveMap_comp]
   212	  exact (congrArg (classDeg q.asIdeal.ResidueField) hpic.symm).trans
   213	    (hinv.trans hdegp)

   215	/-- At degree at least the genus, H1 vanishing makes datum H0 nontrivial. -/
   216	theorem nontrivial_hModule_zero_of_degree_of_h1
   217	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
   218	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra B L]
   219	    [IsScalarTower k B L] (n g : ℕ)
   220	    (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   221	    (hdeg : classDeg L (D.baseChange L).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ))
   222	    (hgn : g ≤ n)
   223	    (hsub : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange L).sheaf 1)) :
   224	    Nontrivial (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange L).sheaf 0) := by
   225	  set P : (relCurve C L).MeromorphicPresentation :=
   226	    Scheme.MeromorphicPresentation.ofCocycle (D.baseChange L).pointedCover
   227	      (gluedSubordCocycle (D.baseChange L).isGluingCocycle
   228	        (D.baseChange L).pointedCover (D.baseChange L).pieceIndex
   229	        fun _ => le_rfl) with hP
   230	  have hsubP : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (P.gluedSheaf L) 1) :=
   231	    (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv
   232	      (BasicOpenCocycleDatum.presentationSheafIso (D.baseChange L))
   233	      1).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mp hsub
   234	  have h0eq : Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf = Sheaf.h0 (P.gluedSheaf L) :=
   235	    Sheaf.h0_congr
   236	      (BasicOpenCocycleDatum.presentationSheafIso (D.baseChange L))
   237	  have hformula := h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi L P hsubP
   238	  have hPclass : P.picClass = (D.baseChange L).cechPicClass := rfl
   239	  have hint : (Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf : ℤ) =
   240	      (n : ℤ) + 1 - (g : ℤ) := by
   241	    rw [h0eq, hformula, hPclass, hdeg,
   242	      chi_relCurve_baseField C L g hchi]
   243	    ring
   244	  have hposZ : (0 : ℤ) < (Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf : ℤ) := by
   245	    rw [hint]
   246	    omega
   247	  have hpos : 0 < Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf := by
   248	    exact_mod_cast hposZ
   249	  exact Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos hpos

   252	theorem classDeg_baseChange_eq_h0_sub_chi
   253	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
   254	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra B L]
   255	    [IsScalarTower k B L] (g : ℕ)

   257	    (hsub : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange L).sheaf 1)) :
   258	    classDeg L (D.baseChange L).cechPicClass =

   267	      (BasicOpenCocycleDatum.presentationSheafIso (D.baseChange L))

   269	  have h0eq : Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf = Sheaf.h0 (P.gluedSheaf L) :=

   271	      (BasicOpenCocycleDatum.presentationSheafIso (D.baseChange L))
   272	  have hformula := h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi L P hsubP
   273	  have hPclass : P.picClass = (D.baseChange L).cechPicClass := rfl

   277	/-- Free H0 and vanishing H1 make one field-fibre degree valid on every fibre. -/
   278	theorem classDeg_baseChange_eq_of_freeH0_of_one
   279	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
   280	    [Module.Free B (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0)] (g n : ℕ)
   281	    (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   282	    (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1)
   283	    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra B K]
   284	    [IsScalarTower k B K]
   285	    (hdegK : classDeg K (D.baseChange K).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ)) :
   286	    ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra B L]
   287	      [IsScalarTower k B L],
   288	      classDeg L (D.baseChange L).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ) := by
   289	  letI : Nontrivial B := RingHom.domain_nontrivial (algebraMap B K)
   290	  intro L _ _ _ _
   291	  have hsubL : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange L).sheaf 1) :=
   292	    D.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange L hH1
   293	  have hsubK : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange K).sheaf 1) :=
   294	    D.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange K hH1
   295	  have h0eq : Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf =
   296	      Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange K).sheaf := by
   297	    change Module.finrank L (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange L).sheaf 0) =
   298	      Module.finrank K (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange K).sheaf 0)
   299	    calc
   300	      _ = Module.finrank L (L ⊗[B] Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) :=
   301	        (D.datumH0BaseChange L hH1).finrank_eq.symm
   302	      _ = Module.finrank B (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) := Module.finrank_baseChange
   303	      _ = Module.finrank K (K ⊗[B] Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) :=
   304	        Module.finrank_baseChange.symm
   305	      _ = _ := (D.datumH0BaseChange K hH1).finrank_eq
   306	  calc
   307	    _ = (Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf : ℤ) - (1 - (g : ℤ)) :=
   308	      D.classDeg_baseChange_eq_h0_sub_chi L g hchi hsubL
   309	    _ = (Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange K).sheaf : ℤ) - (1 - (g : ℤ)) := by
   310	      rw [h0eq]
   311	    _ = classDeg K (D.baseChange K).cechPicClass :=
   312	      (D.classDeg_baseChange_eq_h0_sub_chi K g hchi hsubK).symm
   313	    _ = (n : ℤ) := hdegK

   316	-- The two localization stages synthesize large sheaf and scalar-tower terms.
   317	/-- An admissible H1-vanishing fibre spreads across two away localizations to a
   318	widened divisor family whose class is the pullback of the original datum class.
   319	The returned prime of the final base lies over the chosen input prime. -/
   320	theorem exists_away_away_divFamZarAff_of_admissible_fibre
   321	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi) [IsNoetherianRing B]
   322	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom) (n g : ℕ)
   323	    (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   324	    (hgn : g ≤ n)
   325	    (p : PrimeSpectrum B) (hp : D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   326	    (hdegp : classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   327	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   328	        D.cechPicClass) = (n : ℤ)) :
   329	    ∃ h : B, h ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
   330	      ∃ q₁ : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away h),
   331	        PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B (Localization.Away h)) q₁ = p ∧
   332	        ∃ f : Localization.Away h, f ∉ q₁.asIdeal ∧
   333	          ∃ q₂ : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away f),
   334	            PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f)) q₂ = p ∧
   335	            ∃ F : DivFamZarAff C (Localization.Away f) n,
   336	              F.picClass = Scheme.CechPic.map
   337	                (relCurveMap C B (Localization.Away f)) D.cechPicClass := by
   338	  obtain ⟨h, hh, hvan⟩ := D.exists_basicOpen_h1_vanishing hpi p hp
   339	  obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁⟩ : p ∈ Set.range
   340	      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B (Localization.Away h))) := by
   341	    rw [PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range (Localization.Away h) h]
   342	    exact hh
   343	  let D₁ : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C (Localization.Away h) pi :=
   344	    D.baseChange (Localization.Away h)
   345	  have hfib₁ : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away h),
   346	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D₁).H1 ⊗[Localization.Away h]
   347	        q.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
   348	    intro q
   349	    exact D.hfib_baseChange_away h hvan q
   350	  obtain ⟨-, hfin₁, hproj₁⟩ := datumRigidEngine D₁ hpi hfib₁
   351	  letI : Module.Finite (Localization.Away h) (Sheaf.HModule D₁.sheaf 0) := hfin₁
   352	  letI : Module.Projective (Localization.Away h) (Sheaf.HModule D₁.sheaf 0) := hproj₁
   353	  have hH1₁ : Subsingleton (datumPair D₁).H1 :=
   354	    datum_subsingleton_pairH1 D₁ hpi hfib₁
   355	  have hdeg₁ : classDeg q₁.asIdeal.ResidueField
   356	      (D₁.baseChange q₁.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ) := by
   357	    rw [D₁.cechPicClass_baseChange q₁.asIdeal.ResidueField]
   358	    rw [show D₁.cechPicClass = Scheme.CechPic.map
   359	        (relCurveMap C B (Localization.Away h)) D.cechPicClass from
   360	          D.cechPicClass_baseChange (Localization.Away h),
   361	      ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, relCurveMap_comp]
   362	    exact D.classDeg_map_residueField_of_comap p q₁ hq₁ n hdegp
   363	  have hsub₁ : Subsingleton
   364	      (Sheaf.HModule (D₁.baseChange q₁.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf 1) :=
   365	    D₁.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange q₁.asIdeal.ResidueField hH1₁
   366	  have hnonzero₁ : Nontrivial
   367	      (Sheaf.HModule (D₁.baseChange q₁.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf 0) :=
   368	    D₁.nontrivial_hModule_zero_of_degree_of_h1 q₁.asIdeal.ResidueField
   369	      n g hchi hdeg₁ hgn hsub₁
   370	  have hnontrivialFibre : Nontrivial
   371	      (q₁.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[Localization.Away h]
   372	        Sheaf.HModule D₁.sheaf 0) :=
   373	    (D₁.datumH0BaseChange q₁.asIdeal.ResidueField hH1₁).toEquiv.nontrivial_congr.mpr
   374	      hnonzero₁

   376	    (Q := Sheaf.HModule D₁.sheaf 0) q₁

   378	      (PrimeSpectrum.comap
   379	        (algebraMap (Localization.Away h) (Localization.Away f))) := by

    11	/-!
    12	# DAT-C C2 — the rank-1 H⁰ export and the generator kit
    13	(`informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` GAP-3 Σ-RANK1, §2 (N1)/(N3))
    14	
    15	On the fibrewise h¹-vanishing locus, at fibre degree `n` with the base χ-normalization
    16	`χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n`, the datum engine's `H⁰` is an **invertible** module: finite,
    17	projective, and of stalk-rank exactly `1`.  This is the rank export the engine
    18	(`datumRigidEngine`, `Cohomology/GluedSheafEngine.lean`) leaves open — it delivers
    19	finite + projective, never `rankAtStalk = 1`.
    20	
    21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chi_relCurve` — the χ transport `χ(𝒪_{C_L}) = 1 − n` to every
    22	  field `L` of the test tower (base-field invariance of the genus, `chi_moduleKSheaf`
    23	  + `genus_baseField`; a re-derivation of the private lemma of `DivSchemeMonoBridgeRel`).
    24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one` — **the fibre
    25	  computation**: for a datum whose fibre class over `L` has `classDeg = n`, with `H¹` of
    26	  the base-changed sheaf vanishing, `h⁰(C_L, F_{D_L}) = 1` — the Riemann–Roch anchor
    27	  `h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi` (`n + (1 − n)`) read through the presentation
    28	  bridge `presentationSheafIso`.  The fibre geometric package is threaded as instance
    29	  arguments (`Curve.BaseChangeInstances`).
    30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one` — **Σ-RANK1,
    31	  the datum-level export**: on the vanishing locus (fibre degree `n`, `χ = 1 − n`),
    32	  `Module.rankAtStalk (H⁰(F_D)) p = 1`.  Route: `Module.rankAtStalk_eq` reads the rank as
    33	  the `κ(p)`-fibre dimension; `datumH0BaseChange` (on the nose) identifies the fibre with
    34	  `H⁰(C_{κ(p)}, F_{D_{κ(p)}})`; the fibre computation above pins it at `1`.
    35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamily.rankAtStalk_divisorDatum_eq_one` — the
    36	  certified-family specialization (**N1**): for `G` landing in the h¹-vanishing locus
    37	  `V`, the divisor datum `D_G := G.adaptation.divisorDatum` has invertible `H⁰`.  The
    38	  fibre-degree hypothesis is discharged uniformly by `DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass` (the
    39	  fibre class has `classDeg = n` at every field).
    40	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamily.exists_fibrewise_generator_divisorDatum`
    41	  — **N3, the generator kit**: since `H⁰(F_{D_G})` is projective of rank `1` (hence has a
    42	  nontrivial fibre at every prime of the locus), a fibrewise-nonzero **global** section
    43	  exists Zariski-locally (`Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective`).
    44	
    45	Noetherian discipline (worksheet §2): every rank statement carries `[IsNoetherianRing S]`

    82	`DivSchemeMonoBridgeRel` private lemma). -/
    83	theorem chi_relCurve (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
    84	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    85	    Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) = 1 - (n : ℤ) := by
    86	  haveI : IsProper (baseChangeBundle C L).hom := instIsProperSndLeft C L
    87	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (baseChangeBundle C L).hom :=
    88	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionSndLeft C L
    89	  haveI : GeometricallyIrreducible (baseChangeBundle C L).hom :=
    90	    instGeometricallyIrreducibleSndLeft C L
    91	  have h1 : Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L)
    92	      = 1 - (genus (baseChangeBundle C L) : ℤ) := chi_moduleKSheaf (baseChangeBundle C L)
    93	  have h2 : genus (baseChangeBundle C L) = genus C := genus_baseField C L
    94	  have h3 : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (genus C : ℤ) := chi_moduleKSheaf C
    95	  have h4 : (genus C : ℤ) = (n : ℤ) := by rw [h3] at hχ; linarith
    96	  rw [h1, h2, h4]

    98	/-! ## The fibre computation: `h⁰(C_L, F_{D_L}) = 1`
    99

   101	arguments — they cannot be synthesized through the `relCurve` `def` barrier, so consumers
   102	install them by `haveI` (the `degAt_abelDiv` block, I-0249 (iv)) before calling. -/

   105	`classDeg = n`, with the base χ-normalization and vanishing `H¹` of the base-changed
   106	sheaf, the fibre global-section count is exactly `1` — the Riemann–Roch rank anchor
   107	`h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi` read through the presentation bridge
   108	`presentationSheafIso`, at `n + (1 − n)`. -/
   109	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one
   110	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C S π)
   111	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
   112	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra S L] [IsScalarTower k S L]
   113	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C L)]
   114	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))]
   115	    [QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))]
   116	    [Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0)]
   117	    [Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1)]
   118	    (hg : classDeg L (D.baseChange L).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ))
   119	    (hsub : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange L).sheaf 1)) :
   120	    Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf = 1 := by
   121	  set P : (relCurve C L).MeromorphicPresentation :=
   122	    Scheme.MeromorphicPresentation.ofCocycle (D.baseChange L).pointedCover
   123	      (gluedSubordCocycle (D.baseChange L).isGluingCocycle
   124	        (D.baseChange L).pointedCover (D.baseChange L).pieceIndex
   125	        fun _ => le_rfl) with hP
   126	  have hsubP : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (P.gluedSheaf L) 1) :=
   127	    (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv (presentationSheafIso (D.baseChange L)) 1).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mp
   128	      hsub
   129	  have h0eq : Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf = Sheaf.h0 (P.gluedSheaf L) :=
   130	    Sheaf.h0_congr (presentationSheafIso (D.baseChange L))
   131	  have hformula := h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi L P hsubP
   132	  have hPclass : P.picClass = (D.baseChange L).cechPicClass := rfl
   133	  have hint : (Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf : ℤ) = 1 := by
   134	    rw [h0eq, hformula, hPclass, hg, chi_relCurve hχ L]; ring
   135	  exact_mod_cast hint

   139	/-- **Σ-RANK1, the datum-level rank export** (worksheet GAP-3): on the fibrewise
   140	h¹-vanishing locus, at fibre degree `n` with the base χ-normalization `χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n`,
   141	the datum engine's `H⁰` has stalk-rank exactly `1` at `p`.
   142	
   143	`Module.rankAtStalk_eq` reads the rank as the `κ(p)`-dimension of the fibre
   144	`κ(p) ⊗[S] H⁰`; the on-the-nose base change `datumH0BaseChange` identifies this fibre with
   145	`H⁰(C_{κ(p)}, F_{D_{κ(p)}})`, whose dimension is `1` by the fibre computation. The global
   146	fibrewise hypothesis `hfib` supplies finiteness/projectivity (hence flatness) through
   147	`datumRigidEngine`. -/
   148	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one
   149	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C S π) [IsNoetherianRing S]
   150	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   151	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
   152	    (hfib : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S,
   153	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[S] q.asIdeal.ResidueField))
   154	    (p : PrimeSpectrum S)
   155	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField)]
   156	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
   157	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
   158	    [QuasiCompact
   159	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
   160	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   161	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 0)]
   162	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   163	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1)]
   164	    (hg : classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   165	      (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ)) :
   166	    Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p = 1 := by
   167	  obtain ⟨-, hfin, hproj⟩ := datumRigidEngine D hπ hfib
   168	  haveI := hfin
   169	  haveI := hproj
   170	  have hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1 := datum_subsingleton_pairH1 D hπ hfib
   171	  have hfibre : Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf = 1 :=
   172	    D.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one hχ p.asIdeal.ResidueField hg
   173	      (D.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField hH1)
   174	  calc Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p
   175	      = Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   176	          (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[S] (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0)) :=
   177	        Module.rankAtStalk_eq p
   178	    _ = Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   179	          (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf 0) :=
   180	        (D.datumH0BaseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField hH1).finrank_eq
   181	    _ = Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf := rfl
   182	    _ = 1 := hfibre

   186	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] in
   187	/-- (Implementation) The fibre class of the divisor datum has `classDeg = n` at `κ(p)`:
   188	the base change of `G.eqns`, read through `DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass`. -/
   189	private theorem CertifiedDivisorFamily.classDeg_baseChange_divisorDatum
   190	    (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C S π n) (p : PrimeSpectrum S)
   191	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField)]
   192	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
   193	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
   194	    [QuasiCompact
   195	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
   196	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   197	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 0)]
   198	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   199	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1)] :
   200	    classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   201	      (G.adaptation.divisorDatum.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ) := by
   202	  have hcl : G.adaptation.divisorDatum.cechPicClass = (DivFam.mk G).toZar.picClass := by
   203	    rw [G.adaptation.cechPicClass_divisorDatum, DivFamZar.picClass_toZar, DivFam.picClass_mk]
   204	  rw [G.adaptation.divisorDatum.cechPicClass_baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField, hcl,

   207	    (DivFamZar.mapAlg p.asIdeal.ResidueField n (DivFam.mk G).toZar)

   209	/-- **N1 — invertibility of the canonical `H⁰`** (worksheet §2 (N1)): for a certified
   210	divisor family `G` landing in the h¹-vanishing locus `V` (`hvan`), the divisor datum
   211	`D_G := G.adaptation.divisorDatum` has `H⁰` of stalk-rank exactly `1` at every prime.

   214	the fibre class of `D_G` at `κ(p)` is the base change of `G.eqns`, which has
   215	`classDeg = n` at every field (`DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass`). -/
   216	theorem CertifiedDivisorFamily.rankAtStalk_divisorDatum_eq_one
   217	    (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C S π n) [IsNoetherianRing S]
   218	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   219	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))

   226	  haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   227	    instIsIntegralBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField

   229	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :=

   232	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :=

   235	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 0) :=
   236	    instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   237	  haveI : Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   238	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1) :=
   239	    instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   240	  exact G.adaptation.divisorDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one hπ hχ hfib p

   242	
   243	/-- **N3 — the generator kit** (worksheet §2 (N3)): since `H⁰(F_{D_G})` is projective of

   248	theorem CertifiedDivisorFamily.exists_fibrewise_generator_divisorDatum
   249	    (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C S π n) [IsNoetherianRing S]
   250	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   251	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
   252	    (hvan : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum S, (DivFam.mk G).toZar.IsH1VanishingAt p)
   253	    (p : PrimeSpectrum S) :
   254	    ∃ f : S, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ ∃ q : Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0,

   257	            Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0 ⊗[S] q'.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0 := by
   258	  have hfib : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S,
   259	      Subsingleton ((datumPair G.adaptation.divisorDatum).H1 ⊗[S] q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   260	    fun q => (G.isH1VanishingAt_toZar_iff q).mp (hvan q)

   262	  haveI := hfin
   263	  haveI := hproj
   264	  have hrank : Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0) p = 1 :=

   266	  -- rank 1 ⟹ the `κ(p)`-fibre is nontrivial
   267	  have hfr : Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   268	      (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[S] Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0) = 1 := by
   269	    rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq]; exact hrank

   271	      Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0) :=
   272	    Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (by rw [hfr]; norm_num)
   273	  have hnt : Nontrivial (Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0 ⊗[S]
   274	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   275	    (TensorProduct.comm S _ _).toEquiv.symm.nontrivial

    10	# The fibre steps of the W6-full discharge chain (DAT-3, steps (a) and (b))
    11	
    12	The first two links of the §3.1 discharge chain of `informal/w4-datum-worksheet.md`, at
    13	a fibre `p` of the test ring `B`, for the pinned cocycle datum
    14	`D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π`:
    15	
    16	* **(a), the right-exactness half** — `TwoLatticePair.h1BaseChangeEquiv`: for any
    17	  two-lattice pair `P` over `R` and any `R`-algebra `A`, base change of `H¹` is the
    18	  cokernel of the base-changed Čech differential,
    19	  `A ⊗[R] H¹(P) ≃ₗ[A] (A ⊗[R] N) ⧸ range (P.diff.baseChange A)` (right-exactness of
    20	  `A ⊗[R] -` through the landed `LinearMap.quotRangeBaseChangeEquiv`); on the datum at
    21	  `A := κ(p)` this is `datum_subsingleton_h1_residueField_tensor_iff`, the engine's
    22	  complex-form fibre hypothesis `hfib` as a vanishing condition on the base-changed

     8	/-!
     9	# Canonical pushforward base change for scheme modules
    10	
    11	For a cartesian square of schemes, `canonicalBaseChangeMap` is the Beck--Chevalley mate
    12	
    13	```text
    14	g^* f_* M --> f'_* (g')^* M.
    15	```
    16	
    17	The two coherence theorems identify its pullback followed by the counit with the pullback of
    18	the original counit.  Invertibility is deliberately not asserted here: it is a property of the
    19	module and square, not part of the construction of the canonical map.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	set_option autoImplicit false
    23	
    24	universe u
    25	
    26	open CategoryTheory Limits
    27	
    28	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    29	
    30	/-- The canonical Beck--Chevalley mate for pushforward along a cartesian square. -/
    31	noncomputable def canonicalBaseChangeMap
    32	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    33	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    34	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    35	    Scheme.Modules.pushforward f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback g ⟶
    36	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' :=
    37	  CategoryTheory.mateEquiv
    38	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
    39	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f')
    40	    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    41	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    42	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).hom)
    43	
    44	/-- Pulling back the canonical mate and evaluating recovers its defining pullback telescope. -/
    45	theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_pullback_counit
    46	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    47	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    48	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : X.Modules) :
    49	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M) ≫
    50	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
    51	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M) =
    52	      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    53	        Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    54	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).hom).app
    55	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)) ≫
    56	        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
    57	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M) := by
    58	  rw [canonicalBaseChangeMap]
    59	  exact CategoryTheory.mateEquiv_counit _ _ _ M
    60	
    61	/-- After cancelling the pullback telescope, the base-changed counit is the pulled-back
    62	original counit. -/
    63	theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel
    64	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    65	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    66	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : X.Modules) :
    67	    ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    68	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    69	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).inv).app
    70	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)) ≫

   277	/-- Free H0 and vanishing H1 make one field-fibre degree valid on every fibre. -/
   278	theorem classDeg_baseChange_eq_of_freeH0_of_one
   279	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
   280	    [Module.Free B (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0)] (g n : ℕ)
   281	    (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   282	    (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1)
   283	    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra B K]
   284	    [IsScalarTower k B K]
   285	    (hdegK : classDeg K (D.baseChange K).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ)) :
   286	    ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra B L]
   287	      [IsScalarTower k B L],
   288	      classDeg L (D.baseChange L).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ) := by
   289	  letI : Nontrivial B := RingHom.domain_nontrivial (algebraMap B K)
   290	  intro L _ _ _ _
   291	  have hsubL : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange L).sheaf 1) :=
   292	    D.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange L hH1
   293	  have hsubK : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange K).sheaf 1) :=
   294	    D.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange K hH1
   295	  have h0eq : Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf =
   296	      Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange K).sheaf := by
   297	    change Module.finrank L (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange L).sheaf 0) =
   298	      Module.finrank K (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange K).sheaf 0)
   299	    calc
   300	      _ = Module.finrank L (L ⊗[B] Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) :=
   301	        (D.datumH0BaseChange L hH1).finrank_eq.symm
   302	      _ = Module.finrank B (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) := Module.finrank_baseChange
   303	      _ = Module.finrank K (K ⊗[B] Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) :=
   304	        Module.finrank_baseChange.symm
   305	      _ = _ := (D.datumH0BaseChange K hH1).finrank_eq

   307	    _ = (Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf : ℤ) - (1 - (g : ℤ)) :=
   308	      D.classDeg_baseChange_eq_h0_sub_chi L g hchi hsubL
   309	    _ = (Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange K).sheaf : ℤ) - (1 - (g : ℤ)) := by
   310	      rw [h0eq]
   311	    _ = classDeg K (D.baseChange K).cechPicClass :=
   312	      (D.classDeg_baseChange_eq_h0_sub_chi K g hchi hsubK).symm
   313	    _ = (n : ℤ) := hdegK

   316	-- The two localization stages synthesize large sheaf and scalar-tower terms.
   317	/-- An admissible H1-vanishing fibre spreads across two away localizations to a
   318	widened divisor family whose class is the pullback of the original datum class.
   319	The returned prime of the final base lies over the chosen input prime. -/
   320	theorem exists_away_away_divFamZarAff_of_admissible_fibre
   321	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi) [IsNoetherianRing B]
   322	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom) (n g : ℕ)
   323	    (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   324	    (hgn : g ≤ n)
   325	    (p : PrimeSpectrum B) (hp : D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   326	    (hdegp : classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   327	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   328	        D.cechPicClass) = (n : ℤ)) :
   329	    ∃ h : B, h ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
   330	      ∃ q₁ : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away h),
   331	        PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B (Localization.Away h)) q₁ = p ∧
   332	        ∃ f : Localization.Away h, f ∉ q₁.asIdeal ∧
   333	          ∃ q₂ : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away f),
   334	            PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f)) q₂ = p ∧
   335	            ∃ F : DivFamZarAff C (Localization.Away f) n,
   336	              F.picClass = Scheme.CechPic.map
   337	                (relCurveMap C B (Localization.Away f)) D.cechPicClass := by
   338	  obtain ⟨h, hh, hvan⟩ := D.exists_basicOpen_h1_vanishing hpi p hp
   339	  obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁⟩ : p ∈ Set.range
   340	      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B (Localization.Away h))) := by
   341	    rw [PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range (Localization.Away h) h]
   342	    exact hh
   343	  let D₁ : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C (Localization.Away h) pi :=
   344	    D.baseChange (Localization.Away h)
   345	  have hfib₁ : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away h),
   346	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D₁).H1 ⊗[Localization.Away h]
   347	        q.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
   348	    intro q
   349	    exact D.hfib_baseChange_away h hvan q
   350	  obtain ⟨-, hfin₁, hproj₁⟩ := datumRigidEngine D₁ hpi hfib₁
   351	  letI : Module.Finite (Localization.Away h) (Sheaf.HModule D₁.sheaf 0) := hfin₁
   352	  letI : Module.Projective (Localization.Away h) (Sheaf.HModule D₁.sheaf 0) := hproj₁
   353	  have hH1₁ : Subsingleton (datumPair D₁).H1 :=
   354	    datum_subsingleton_pairH1 D₁ hpi hfib₁
   355	  have hdeg₁ : classDeg q₁.asIdeal.ResidueField
   356	      (D₁.baseChange q₁.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ) := by
   357	    rw [D₁.cechPicClass_baseChange q₁.asIdeal.ResidueField]
   358	    rw [show D₁.cechPicClass = Scheme.CechPic.map
   359	        (relCurveMap C B (Localization.Away h)) D.cechPicClass from
   360	          D.cechPicClass_baseChange (Localization.Away h),
   361	      ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, relCurveMap_comp]
   362	    exact D.classDeg_map_residueField_of_comap p q₁ hq₁ n hdegp
   363	  have hsub₁ : Subsingleton
   364	      (Sheaf.HModule (D₁.baseChange q₁.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf 1) :=
   365	    D₁.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange q₁.asIdeal.ResidueField hH1₁
   366	  have hnonzero₁ : Nontrivial
   367	      (Sheaf.HModule (D₁.baseChange q₁.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf 0) :=
   368	    D₁.nontrivial_hModule_zero_of_degree_of_h1 q₁.asIdeal.ResidueField
   369	      n g hchi hdeg₁ hgn hsub₁
   370	  have hnontrivialFibre : Nontrivial
   371	      (q₁.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[Localization.Away h]
   372	        Sheaf.HModule D₁.sheaf 0) :=
   373	    (D₁.datumH0BaseChange q₁.asIdeal.ResidueField hH1₁).toEquiv.nontrivial_congr.mpr
   374	      hnonzero₁
   375	  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfree⟩ := Grassmannian.exists_away_free
   376	    (Q := Sheaf.HModule D₁.sheaf 0) q₁
   377	  obtain ⟨q₂, hq₂'⟩ : q₁ ∈ Set.range
   378	      (PrimeSpectrum.comap
   379	        (algebraMap (Localization.Away h) (Localization.Away f))) := by
   380	    rw [PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range (Localization.Away f) f]

    69	/-- An admissible fibre of a cocycle datum over an arbitrary affine base lifts to a widened

    71	theorem exists_etale_divFamZarAff_of_admissible_fibre
    72	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    73	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom) (n g : ℕ)
    74	    (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    75	    (hgn : g ≤ n)
    76	    (hdeg : ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra B K]
    77	      [IsScalarTower k B K],
    78	      classDeg K (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B K) D.cechPicClass) =
    79	        (n : ℤ))
    80	    (p : PrimeSpectrum B)
    81	    (hp : D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    82	    ∃ (S : Type u) (_ : CommRing S) (_ : Algebra k S) (_ : Algebra B S)
    83	      (_ : IsScalarTower k B S) (_ : Algebra.Etale B S)
    84	      (q : PrimeSpectrum S),
    85	      PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B S) q = p ∧
    86	        ∃ F : DivFamZarAff C S n,
    87	          F.picClass = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B S) D.cechPicClass := by
    88	  obtain ⟨B₀, -, hnoeth, D₀, hbc⟩ := D.exists_fg_isNoetherianRing_baseChange_eq
    89	  letI : IsNoetherianRing (↑B₀) := hnoeth

    92	    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap (↑B₀) B) p
    93	  have hcom : p₀.asIdeal = p.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap (↑B₀) B) := rfl
    94	  let rho : p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField →ₐ[k] p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    95	    Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p₀.asIdeal p.asIdeal phi hcom
    96	  letI : Algebra p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    97	    rho.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    98	  haveI : IsScalarTower k p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    99	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (rho.commutes x).symm

   101	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   102	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
   103	      change algebraMap (↑B₀) p.asIdeal.ResidueField x =
   104	        rho (algebraMap (↑B₀) p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField x)
   105	      rw [Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ_apply, Ideal.ResidueField.map_algebraMap]
   106	      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (↑B₀) B p.asIdeal.ResidueField x
   107	  have hclp : Scheme.CechPic.map
   108	      (relCurveMap C (↑B₀) p.asIdeal.ResidueField) D₀.cechPicClass =
   109	      Scheme.CechPic.map
   110	        (relCurveMap C B p.asIdeal.ResidueField) D.cechPicClass := by
   111	    rw [descent_cechPicClass (C := C) (B := B) hbc,
   112	      ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, relCurveMap_comp]
   113	  have hpD₀ : D₀.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=

   115	      D p.asIdeal.ResidueField hclp).mpr hp
   116	  have hp₀ : D₀.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField :=

   118	      p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField p.asIdeal.ResidueField).mpr hpD₀

   141	        (relCurveMap C (↑B₀) p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   142	        D₀.cechPicClass) = (n : ℤ) := by
   143	    calc
   144	      _ = classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   145	          (Scheme.CechPic.map
   146	            (relCurveMap C p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   147	            (Scheme.CechPic.map
   148	              (relCurveMap C (↑B₀) p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField)

   152	            (relCurveMap C B p.asIdeal.ResidueField) D.cechPicClass) := by

   155	  obtain ⟨h, hh, q₁, hq₁, f, hf, q₂, hq₂, F₀, hF₀⟩ :=

   158	  let B₁ := Localization.Away (phi h)
   159	  let phi₁ : Localization.Away h →ₐ[k] B₁ := Localization.awayMapₐ phi h

   161	  let phi₂ : Localization.Away f →ₐ[k] S := Localization.awayMapₐ phi₁ f
   162	  let algBS : Algebra B S :=

   164	  letI : Algebra B S := algBS
   165	  letI : SMul B S := algBS.toSMul
   166	  haveI towerBB₁S : IsScalarTower B B₁ S :=
   167	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
   168	  haveI towerkBS : IsScalarTower k B S :=
   169	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
   170	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, RingHom.comp_assoc,

   172	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k B₁ S])

   174	  letI : Algebra.Etale B₁ S := Algebra.Etale.of_isLocalizationAway (phi₁ f)
   175	  letI : Algebra.Etale B S := Algebra.Etale.comp B B₁ S
   176	  have hph : phi h ∉ p.asIdeal := by
   177	    intro hmem
   178	    apply hh
   179	    exact hmem
   180	  obtain ⟨q₁B, hq₁B⟩ : p ∈ Set.range
   181	      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B B₁)) := by
   182	    rw [PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range B₁ (phi h)]
   183	    exact hph
   184	  have hq₁push : PrimeSpectrum.comap phi₁.toRingHom q₁B = q₁ := by
   185	    apply PrimeSpectrum.localization_comap_injective
   186	      (Localization.Away h) (Submonoid.powers h)
   187	    have hsquare : phi₁.toRingHom.comp
   188	        (algebraMap (↑B₀) (Localization.Away h)) =
   189	        (algebraMap B B₁).comp (algebraMap (↑B₀) B) := by
   190	      ext x
   191	      exact DivFamZar.awayMapₐ_algebraMap phi h x
   192	    calc
   193	      PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap (↑B₀) (Localization.Away h))
   194	          (PrimeSpectrum.comap phi₁.toRingHom q₁B) =
   195	          PrimeSpectrum.comap
   196	            (phi₁.toRingHom.comp

    13	(`informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` GAP-3 Σ-RANK1, §2 (N1)/(N3))
    14	
    15	On the fibrewise h¹-vanishing locus, at fibre degree `n` with the base χ-normalization
    16	`χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n`, the datum engine's `H⁰` is an **invertible** module: finite,
    17	projective, and of stalk-rank exactly `1`.  This is the rank export the engine
    18	(`datumRigidEngine`, `Cohomology/GluedSheafEngine.lean`) leaves open — it delivers
    19	finite + projective, never `rankAtStalk = 1`.
    20	
    21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chi_relCurve` — the χ transport `χ(𝒪_{C_L}) = 1 − n` to every
    22	  field `L` of the test tower (base-field invariance of the genus, `chi_moduleKSheaf`
    23	  + `genus_baseField`; a re-derivation of the private lemma of `DivSchemeMonoBridgeRel`).
    24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one` — **the fibre
    25	  computation**: for a datum whose fibre class over `L` has `classDeg = n`, with `H¹` of
    26	  the base-changed sheaf vanishing, `h⁰(C_L, F_{D_L}) = 1` — the Riemann–Roch anchor
    27	  `h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi` (`n + (1 − n)`) read through the presentation
    28	  bridge `presentationSheafIso`.  The fibre geometric package is threaded as instance
    29	  arguments (`Curve.BaseChangeInstances`).
    30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one` — **Σ-RANK1,
    31	  the datum-level export**: on the vanishing locus (fibre degree `n`, `χ = 1 − n`),
    32	  `Module.rankAtStalk (H⁰(F_D)) p = 1`.  Route: `Module.rankAtStalk_eq` reads the rank as
    33	  the `κ(p)`-fibre dimension; `datumH0BaseChange` (on the nose) identifies the fibre with
    34	  `H⁰(C_{κ(p)}, F_{D_{κ(p)}})`; the fibre computation above pins it at `1`.
    35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamily.rankAtStalk_divisorDatum_eq_one` — the
    36	  certified-family specialization (**N1**): for `G` landing in the h¹-vanishing locus
    37	  `V`, the divisor datum `D_G := G.adaptation.divisorDatum` has invertible `H⁰`.  The

    40	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamily.exists_fibrewise_generator_divisorDatum`
    41	  — **N3, the generator kit**: since `H⁰(F_{D_G})` is projective of rank `1` (hence has a

     9	/-!
    10	# Restricting a scheme module to the base ring
    11	
    12	For a scheme `X` over `Spec k`, this file views an `X.Modules` object as a sheaf of
    13	`k`-modules.  The construction keeps the same section types and restriction maps; only the
    14	scalar action is restricted along `k -> Gamma(X, U)`.  It is the dialect bridge needed to
    15	compare a `Scheme.Modules` line bundle with the fixed-base module sheaves used by the Cech
    16	cohomology engine.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
    26	
    27	variable {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
    28	
    29	/-- The base-ring module structure on sections of a scheme module. -/
    30	@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleKSections
    31	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    32	    (U : X.left.Opens) : Module k Γ(M, U) :=
    33	  Module.compHom _ (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U)
    34	
    35	attribute [local instance] moduleKSections
    36	
    37	/-- The native structure-sheaf action, with section-notation binders kept explicit. -/
    38	private noncomputable def smulSection
    39	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    40	    (U : X.left.Opens) (r : Γ(X.left, U)) (x : Γ(M, U)) : Γ(M, U) :=
    41	  r • x
    42	
    43	/-- The presheaf underlying a scheme module after restriction of scalars to the base ring. -/
    44	noncomputable def toModuleKPresheafOfModules
    45	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    46	    X.left.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k where
    47	  obj U := ModuleCat.of k Γ(M, U.unop)
    48	  map {U V} f := ModuleCat.ofHom
    49	    { toFun := fun x => M.presheaf.map f x
    50	      map_add' := fun x y => map_add _ x y
    51	      map_smul' := fun r x =>
    52	        (Scheme.Modules.map_smul M f.unop (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U.unop r) x).trans
    53	          (congrArg
    54	            (fun (s : Γ(X.left, V.unop)) =>
    55	              smulSection X M V.unop s (M.presheaf.map f x))
    56	            (X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k f r)) }
    57	  map_id U := by
    58	    ext x
    59	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (f : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj U) =>
    60	      (ConcreteCategory.hom f : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_id U)) x
    61	  map_comp {U V W} f g := by
    62	    ext x
    63	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (h : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj W) =>
    64	      (ConcreteCategory.hom h : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_comp f g)) x
    65	
    66	/-- The restricted presheaf is a sheaf because its underlying additive presheaf is unchanged. -/
    67	lemma toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf
    68	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    69	    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat)
    70	      (toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M) := by
    71	  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _ (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} k))]
    72	  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    73	      (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).mp (Scheme.Modules.isSheaf M) using 1 <;> rfl
    74	
    75	/-- A sheaf of `O_X`-modules, viewed as a sheaf of modules over the base ring. -/
    76	noncomputable def toModuleKSheafOfModules
    77	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    78	    Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat) (ModuleCat.{u} k) :=
    79	  ⟨toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M, toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf X M⟩
    80	
    81	/-- Restriction maps of the base-ring sheaf are definitionally those of the scheme module. -/
    82	lemma toModuleKSheafOfModules_obj_map_apply
    83	    {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (M : X.left.Modules)
    84	    {V W : X.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V)
    85	    (x : (toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.obj (op V)) :
    86	    ((toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom x =
    87	      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x :=
    88	  rfl

    95	def IsLineBundle (M : X.Modules) : Prop :=
    96	  ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
    97	    Nonempty ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅ SheafOfModules.unit U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    98	
    99	end Modules

   158	/-- The base change of the two-cover degree-zero term `F(V₀ᴮ) × F(V₁ᴮ)`. -/
   159	noncomputable def datumDomBaseChange :
   160	    B' ⊗[B] ((D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   161	        (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) ≃ₗ[B']
   162	      ((D.baseChange B').sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   163	        ((D.baseChange B').sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)) :=
   164	  (TensorProduct.prodRight B B' B' _ _).trans
   165	    ((D.termBaseChange₀ B').prodCongr (D.termBaseChange₁ B'))

   167	/-- The degree-zero term base change on a pure tensor. -/
   168	lemma datumDomBaseChange_tmul (b' : B')
   169	    (p : (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   170	      (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) :
   171	    D.datumDomBaseChange B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p) =
   172	      (D.termBaseChange₀ B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p.1), D.termBaseChange₁ B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p.2)) := by
   173	  rw [datumDomBaseChange, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, TensorProduct.prodRight_tmul]
   174	  rfl

   177	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   178	/-- **The δ-naturality square** (the glued analogue of `relTwistDiffBaseChange`): the base
   179	change of the datum's Čech differential over `B` is carried to the datum's Čech differential
   180	over `B'` under the term identifications. There is no cocycle conjugation — the componentwise
   181	restrictions commute with `sectionsMap` through `gluedRes_sectionsMap`. -/
   182	theorem datumDiffBaseChange
   183	    (x : B' ⊗[B] ((D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   184	      (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)))) :
   185	    D.termBaseChangeInf B' (((datumPair D).diff).baseChange B' x) =
   186	      (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff (D.datumDomBaseChange B' x) := by
   187	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
   188	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
   189	  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
   190	  | tmul b' p =>
   191	    have hbc : ((datumPair D).diff).baseChange B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p) =
   192	        b' ⊗ₜ[B] (datumPair D).diff p := LinearMap.baseChange_tmul _ _ _
   193	    rw [hbc]
   194	    simp only [D.datumDomBaseChange_tmul B', TwoLatticePair.diff_apply,
   195	      D.termBaseChange₀_tmul B', D.termBaseChange₁_tmul B']
   196	    rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, map_sub, D.termBaseChangeInf_tmul B',
   197	      D.termBaseChangeInf_tmul B', map_smul, map_smul]
   198	    congr 1
   199	    · congr 1
   200	      exact (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B'
   201	        (inf_le_left : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   202	          (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
   203	        (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₀)
   204	        (le_preimage_chart B' ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁))
   205	        (inf_le_left : (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   206	          (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
   207	        p.1).symm
   208	    · congr 1
   209	      exact (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B'
   210	        (inf_le_right : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   211	          (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
   212	        (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₁)
   213	        (le_preimage_chart B' ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁))
   214	        (inf_le_right : (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   215	          (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
   216	        p.2).symm

   218	/-! ## The on-the-nose H⁰ base change and H¹ vanishing -/
   219	
   220	open AlgebraicJacobian
   221	
   222	/-- **`H⁰` base change on the nose** (DAT-1 (1d-ii) tail; the RE-5/DAT-B transport interface):
   223	on the vanishing locus, for every ring map `B → B'`,
   224	
   225	`B' ⊗[B] H⁰(C_B, F_D) ≃ₗ[B'] H⁰(C_{B'}, F_{D'})`
   226	
   227	with `D' = D.baseChange B'` — the abstract kernel clause `datumH0BaseChangeEquiv` threaded
   228	through the term identifications by the δ-naturality square `datumDiffBaseChange`. -/
   229	noncomputable def datumH0BaseChange (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) :
   230	    B' ⊗[B] (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B']
   231	      Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 0 :=
   232	  (datumH0BaseChangeEquiv D hH1 B').trans
   233	    ((RigidEngine.kerCongr ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange B')
   234	        ((datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff)
   235	        (D.datumDomBaseChange B') (D.termBaseChangeInf B')
   236	        (fun x => D.datumDiffBaseChange B' x)).trans
   237	      ((D.baseChange B').pairData.h0Equiv
   238	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   239	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   240	        (relCover_sup C B' (fiberTwoCover π))).symm)
   241	
   242	/-- **`H¹` vanishes after base change** on the vanishing locus: the base-changed Čech
   243	differential is surjective (right-exactness of `B' ⊗[B] -` plus the δ-square), so `H¹` of the
   244	base-changed datum sheaf vanishes. -/
   245	theorem datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) :
   246	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 1) := by
   247	  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (datumPair D).diff :=
   248	    D.pairData.surjective_diff (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π))
   249	      (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover π)) hH1
   250	  have hbc : Function.Surjective ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange B') := by
   251	    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor]
   252	    exact LinearMap.lTensor_surjective B' hsurj
   253	  have hsurj' : Function.Surjective (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff :=
   254	    RigidEngine.surjective_congr _ _ (D.datumDomBaseChange B') (D.termBaseChangeInf B')
   255	      (fun x => D.datumDiffBaseChange B' x) hbc
   256	  haveI : Subsingleton (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).H1 := by
   257	    have h : (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).imageLattice = ⊤ := by
   258	      rw [← (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).range_diff_eq, LinearMap.range_eq_top]
   259	      exact hsurj'
   260	    rw [TwoLatticePair.H1, h]
   261	    infer_instance
   262	  exact ((D.baseChange B').pairData.h1Equiv
   263	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   264	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   265	    (relCover_sup C B' (fiberTwoCover π))).toEquiv.subsingleton

     8	/-!
     9	# CHART-U(b) — datum-level openness of the chart-membership (witness) locus
    10	(`informal/w4-datb-worksheet.md` §1.6, `informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` §3.3)
    11	
    12	The affine-level heart of the shared CHART-U(b) brick, stated directly on a pinned
    13	basic-open cocycle datum in the **witness form** the `chartLocus` predicate uses.
    14	
    15	For a datum `D` over an affine base `B`, the locus of primes `q` of `B` at which the
    16	fibre class of `D` at `κ(q)` admits an effective witness divisor with vanishing `H¹`
    17	is Zariski-open in `Spec B`.  This is the single sanctioned openness mechanism of the
    18	campaign (`datumRigidEngine_isOpen_vanishing`, Noetherian-free — dat-d §3.5) read
    19	through the two-way datum dictionary of C1
    20	(`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.subsingleton_h1_tensor_iff_exists_witness`,
    21	`informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` GAP-6): the engine open is the complex-form fibre
    22	condition `Subsingleton (H¹(pair D) ⊗[B] κ(q))`, and the dictionary rewrites it,
    23	pointwise and class-intrinsically, as the effective-witness/h¹-vanishing condition.
    24	
    25	Role in the CHART-U(b) chain (the two unlanded links of §5 risk 1):
    26	
    27	* **the shifted-datum constructor (link 1):** over the étale carrier `B` the plus
    28	  class collapses to an honest Čech class; twisted by the theta layer and DAT-C's
    29	  GAP-1 inverse datum into the `λθᵐ(Σ-shift)⁻¹` class, then extracted
    30	  (`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_cechPicClass_eq`) to a datum `D`.  The output of
    31	  that link is exactly a `BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π` — the input of the theorem
    32	  below, whose witness set is then the `chartLocus`-over-`B`.
    33	* **the étale-image openness transport (link 2):** the locus over the test base `A`
    34	  is the image, under the (open, surjective) étale carrier map `Spec B → Spec A`, of
    35	  the open locus this theorem produces — carried to `A` by mathlib's
    36	  `IsOpenMap.isQuotientMap`/`IsQuotientMap.isOpen_preimage` once the fibre-field
    37	  invariance identifies the preimage.
    38	
    39	The theorem is class-intrinsic (any datum in the class has the same witness set, by
    40	(V1a)), so a change of extracted representative is free.
    41	-/

   103	/-! ## The openness transport (CHART-U(b) link 2, topological half)
   104	
   105	The engine produces the open witness locus over the étale carrier `Spec B` (or, on the
   106	away pieces, over `Spec (Localization.Away f)`).  CHART-U(b)'s transport (ii)
   107	(`w4-datb` §1.6, "the Kleiman tex 2204-2244 step, now one `IsOpenMap` application")

   110	mathematical content of link 2 is the *fibre-field invariance* that identifies the
   111	preimage of the base locus with the carrier locus (`κ(q)/κ(p)` a separable extension;

   113	
   114	/-- **Openness descends along an open continuous surjection**: if `f` is continuous,
   115	open, and surjective and `f ⁻¹' V` is open, then `V` is open — because
   116	`V = f '' (f ⁻¹' V)` (surjectivity) and `f` carries opens to opens.  This is the
   117	topological core of CHART-U(b)'s transport (ii). -/
   118	theorem isOpen_of_isOpen_preimage_of_isOpenMap_surjective

   155	/-- **The shifted-datum presentation hypothesis** — the one link of the CHART-U(b) route of
   156	record that is not landed, stated exactly.
   157	
   158	Over an affine test `Spec A`, for a class `μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)` (in practice the
   159	twisted family `chartTwist C m Z _ λ` restricted to the test), a presentation is a
   160	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum` over `A` whose fibre witness predicate at every residue field agrees
   161	with the split witness predicate of `μ` at the corresponding point.
   162	
   163	Two remarks on the shape, both deliberate:
   164	
   165	* it is stated as an **agreement of predicates at every point**, not as a class equality.
   166	  That is weaker than "the datum's class is `μ`", and it is all the openness argument
   167	  consumes — which matters, because the class equality is what needs `cechPicClass_inv` and
   168	  a class-level identification, whereas a lane that can produce the pointwise agreement by any
   169	  other route may use this theorem immediately;
   170	* the split predicate is read at `Over.testPoint`, i.e. at the canonical residue-field point
   171	  of the affine test, so no choice of affine chart enters;
   172	* the `Algebra A (testPointField t)` / `IsScalarTower k A (testPointField t)` instances the
   173	  datum predicate needs are the **canonical** ones of `Picard/Pic0ChartTestPoint.lean`.  An
   174	  earlier draft of this file carried them as explicit `alg`/`tow` arguments; that was strictly
   175	  worse — it made the statement false for some regradings (`HasWitnessH1Vanishing` reads its
   176	  `Algebra` instance inside `relCurveMap`, so a non-canonical `alg` names a different set) as
   177	  well as unusable. -/
   178	def IsChartDatumPresentation {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   179	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)) (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C A π) : Prop :=
   180	  ∀ t : (overSpec k A).left,
   181	    D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
   182	      ↔ IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ)
   183	
   184	/-! ## The carrier translation: `testPointField` on `Spec A` versus `Ideal.ResidueField`
   185	
   186	The engine's open set lives in `PrimeSpectrum A` and is indexed by `q.asIdeal.ResidueField`;
   187	`chartLocus` lives in `(overSpec k A).left = Spec A` and is indexed by `Over.testPointField`.
   188	The two carriers are the same space, but the two *fields* are only canonically isomorphic
   189	(mathlib's `Spec.residueFieldIso`), so the witness predicate has to be carried across that
   190	isomorphism.  That is what this section does, and it is the transport the (b-amendment) folds
   191	into "affine pieces glue by (V1c)-style locality". -/
   192	
   193	/-- **The residue-field comparison at a point of an affine test, as an algebra map.**
   194	
   195	`Over.testPointField t` is the *scheme* residue field `(Spec A).residueField t`, while every
   196	engine-facing predicate reads the *algebraic* residue field `t.asIdeal.ResidueField` of the
   197	prime.  Mathlib's `Spec.residueFieldIso` identifies them; this records the identification in
   198	the form the tower needs, namely that the canonical `A`-algebra structure on the scheme
   199	residue field (`Over.instAlgebraTestPointFieldAffine`) factors through the algebraic one.
   200	
   201	Proof: both sides are `Spec.preimage` of a morphism out of `Spec κ(t)`, and `Spec.map` is
   202	injective on homs, so it suffices to compare after applying `Spec.map` — where the identity is
   203	mathlib's `Spec.map_residueFieldIso_inv_eq_fromSpecResidueField`. -/
   204	lemma algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine_factors {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   205	    (t : (overSpec k A).left) :
   206	    algebraMap A (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
   207	      = ((Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (.of A) t).inv).hom.comp
   208	          (algebraMap A (t : PrimeSpectrum A).asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
   209	  rw [Over.algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine]
   210	  have h : Spec.preimage ((overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t)
   211	      = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (t : PrimeSpectrum A).asIdeal.ResidueField)
   212	          ≫ (Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (.of A) t).inv := by
   213	    apply Spec.map_injective
   214	    rw [Spec.map_preimage, Spec.map_comp]
   215	    exact (Scheme.Spec.map_residueFieldIso_inv_eq_fromSpecResidueField (.of A) t).symm
   216	  rw [h]
   217	  rfl

   219	/-- **The witness predicate at a scheme-residue field agrees with the one at the prime's
   220	residue field, and the resulting locus is open.**
   221	
   222	`Over.testPointField t` is `(Spec A).residueField t` and the engine reads
   223	`t.asIdeal.ResidueField`; `Spec.residueFieldIso` identifies them, and the witness predicate
   224	transfers along any field extension in the `A`-tower

   228	Three points about the proof, each of which was a suspected wall and is not:
   229	
   230	* the **carrier identification** `↥(overSpec k A).left = PrimeSpectrum A` is *definitional*
   231	  (`Scheme.Spec`'s carrier is `PrimeSpectrum` on the nose), so the two index sets need no
   232	  transport and the two topologies agree by `rfl`.  The set equality below is therefore a
   233	  pointwise `Iff`, not a homeomorphism argument;
   234	* the `Algebra A (testPointField t)` and `IsScalarTower k A (testPointField t)` instances the
   235	  predicate needs are **already canonical** (`Over.instAlgebraTestPointFieldAffine`,

   237	  argument.  An earlier draft of this file took `alg`/`tow` as explicit hypotheses and left
   238	  the conclusion as a `sorry`; that was a statement-shape artifact, not a gap — and worse,
   239	  the hypothesis form is *false for some regradings*, since an arbitrary `alg` need not be the

   241	* the only genuine content is the transport across `Spec.residueFieldIso`, which is
   242	  `hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension` applied to the isomorphism, in the tower
